name: net_session_config_dialog_on_destroy
description: NetSessionConfigDialog::OnDestroy saves the selected map item-data value when the dialog is destroyed. Direct production host: mission.cpp.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x41cb50 validates CWnd::OnDestroy, CB_GETCURSEL on the map combo HWND, CB_GETITEMDATA using the selected combo index, and storage into m_selectedMapIndex at offset 0x60.
The native smoke patches CWnd::OnDestroy and USER32 SendMessageA, then verifies base dispatch, SendMessage order/arguments, and selected map storage.
